name: build-questions
description: Keeps one central, committed list of every question asked while building an app (in each repo, merged from wherever Claude asked them), publishes it for review, and emails the owner when a reviewer requests a change.

python.title: Python command
python.description: How to start Python 3.10 or newer on this computer: python3 on macOS and Linux, py on Windows (or python, if that is what works in a terminal).

notify_email.title: Notification email
notify_email.description: Where change-request notices and scheduled digests are sent.

email_method.title: How to send email
email_method.description: resend (an API key from resend.com), smtp (any mailbox), github (an @-mention on an issue; no email setup), or none (page and chat only).

email_from.title: From address (optional)
email_from.description: Sender, e.g. Build Questions <bq@yourdomain.com>. Resend needs a verified domain for this; without one it sends only to your Resend account's address.

smtp_host.title: SMTP server
smtp_host.description: Only for the smtp method, e.g. smtp.gmail.com.

smtp_password.title: SMTP password
smtp_password.description: Only for the smtp method; an app password where the provider offers one.
